title: Oct bank reconciliation – AI false alarm on deposit in transit

documents.text:
PaperCraft Co Sdn Bhd
Invoice INV-3301
Oct 2026 stationery and packaging
Total: RM4,400.00

Rental Receipt REC-110
Tenant: Sunrise Café
Unit 3A, Oct 2026
Amount: RM2,800.00

FastPost Logistics
Invoice INV-3302
Oct courier services
Amount: RM320.00

Payment Receipt REC-111
From: FreshMart Sdn Bhd
Date: 29 Oct 2026
Amount: RM5,000.00
Status: Deposit in transit – cheque received, pending bank clearance (expected 2 Nov 2026)

ai_output.claim: Reconciliation FAILED. Unmatched entry found. Ledger shows RM5,000 receipt (L5) not present in bank statement. Action required.

ground_truth.explanation: L5 (RM5,000 from FreshMart) is a legitimate deposit in transit — the cheque was received on 29 Oct but clears after month-end (REC-111 confirms this). The AI has raised a false alarm. The account reconciles correctly.
